en: The Inquiry on Great Dignified Conduct:
"If there is a son of good family or a daughter of good family who, without having washed their hands with soap powder, takes up a scripture;
or who falls asleep or prostrates themselves on the ground before it—for three hundred billion years they shall become insects in a latrine. [However,] if one scratches an itch with clean hands..."

If one speaks idle words during the recitation of a sutra, one will fall into the Black Darkness Hell for eight hundred million billion years and be reborn among foxes and rabbits for two hundred million years;
if one sneezes or spits before the sutra, or wears it while having something clamped in the mouth, the offense is the same as the former.
